$comment: Proposed ADMIN permissions for the Prune back office, in the GET /v1/admin/permissions shape without ids/timestamps. A role gets every privilege in each permission it holds, so read access, write access and approvals are separate permissions; that lets roles such as an approver or a read-only auditor be built. Roles list permission actions, not privileges. Role management and assigning roles to admins are Super Admin only, so they have no privileges here. Super Admin is built in and needs no role.
